### The problem

Using the Meater integration, noticed these errors in the logs since updating to beta (could be a coincidence, but did not notice them before beta), and i'll report them anyways. The errors appeared during a cook.

comments:
Hey there @sotolotl, @emontnemery, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`meater`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L624) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
I should mention that the integration appeared to work properly, so not sure if these are transient errors.

The errors are harmless, but we should handle them.

The problem is that the PyPi package only conditionally sets some attributes:
https://github.com/Sotolotl/meater-python/blob/23fb07a66b7edc2b04cf07de623fab445cb3032b/meater/MeaterApi.py#L136-L143

That needs to be handled in the meater integration by checking for attributes.

review_comments: It's easier to read a standalone function if the lambda spans more than one line.
